messages:
Lucy: Starting thread for Concord gateway + LlamaIndex adapter launch. Need timeline, owners, and a demo plan.
Concord PM: Hi! Targeting week of 2024-09-16 for a coordinated blog + marketplace tile + live demo. We can supply logos and a 1-line.
Maria: I'll own marketplace tile copy and submission. Need final 40-80 word summary and logo assets.
Sanjay: Eng can ship a reference adapter and a minimal sample app. Blockers: SSO metadata and API contract schema.
Andrew: DevEx will make quickstart + demo script. Will want sample payloads and a curl snippet.
Eve (Legal): I'll review messaging. Please avoid customer-identifying screenshots unless consented. Also flag any performance claims.
Lucy: Plan: embargo confirmation, legal sign-off, canary demo route, rehearsal dates. Can integrations-bot add checklist?
integrations-bot: Added items: ["SSO metadata"], ["Adapter contract"], ["Quickstart draft"], ["Marketplace copy"], ["Legal review"].
Maria: ETA for draft marketplace copy: 2024-08-20. Concord PM, can you share the short summary by then?
Concord PM: Yes, sending 1-line + logo pack by EOD 2024-08-18. Embargo confirmed 2024-09-16.
Sanjay: If we advertise "plug-and-play" we need a small compatibility matrix for model variants. I'll produce that by 2024-09-06.
Andrew: Quickstart curl example we'll include: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d '{"adapter":"concord","input":"Summarize"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
Lucy: Can we reserve a canary for rehearsals? Two rehearsals: dry run 2024-09-13, final 2024-09-15.
integrations-bot: Canary requested. Assigning deploy to provision demo route.
Lucy: Action owners: Maria (marketplace + copy), Sanjay (adapter + compat matrix), Andrew (quickstart + demo), Eve (legal review), Lucy (coordination + embargo ack).
Maria: I'll drop the marketplace draft into the board on 2024-08-20 and ping for review. :thumbsup:
Concord PM: Thanks! We'll stand by for assets and the embargo acknowledgement.
